text:
rachel (Docs): drafting a small docs section for audit-log handling. need signoff on wording + a tiny Go SDK snippet for setting retention/redaction.
enzo (Security): default hosted retention = 90 days. note: Dedicated/Private can vary by contract. add exports caveat.
priya (Legal): avoid absolute deletion claims. suggested: "Audit logs are retained for operational and compliance purposes for a configurable period. Customers may request retention changes in accordance with their contract; legal holds may supersede retention. We may retain copies where required by law."
rachel (Docs): good — i'll use that. also adding: "Redaction is best-effort; copies exported to third-party sinks may remain unless the customer remediates those sinks."
marco (SDK): small Go snippet draft:
```go
policy, _ := client.Audit.CreatePolicy(context.TODO(), AuditPolicyRequest{
  Key: "session-events",
  RetentionDays: 90,
  RedactionLevel: "pii_full",
})
fmt.Println(policy.PolicyID, policy.EffectiveRetentionDays)
```
marco (SDK): note: SDK maps RetentionDays -> retention_ttl_days for the backend. will add unit test.
jin (Eng): confirmed backend field name is retention_ttl_days. also: we cannot guarantee retroactive redaction for data already exported — include migration runbook link.
rachel (Docs): adding migration checklist and placeholder for runbook link. jin, please update when PR is ready.
priya (Legal): tiny edit: change "customers can request" -> "customers may request changes in accordance with their contract" (to match earlier phrasing).
rachel (Docs): updated. infra-bot: docs PR opened by @rachel: https://redwood.internal/pulls/5417 (docs/audit-log-retention-go-snippet)
marco (SDK): i'll send the SDK patch and tests today. sample response used in docs: {"policy_id":"plc_123","effective_retention_days":90}.
jin (Eng): i'll land the migration runbook PR and add the checklist steps + dry-run instructions. schedule migrations in low-traffic windows.
enzo (Security): include downstream sinks paragraph listing common sinks and recommending customers enforce retention there too (bigquery, snowflake, splunk).
rachel (Docs): done. merging plan: wait 24h after SDK patch, then merge docs and notify customers via changelog. thanks all :raised_hands:
